Card Q&A.q: When using this card's [On Deletion] effect to return [Kimeramon] and [Machinedramon] from my trash to the bottom of my deck, can I return [Kimeramon] and [Machinedramon] that were in this card's digivolution cards to the bottom of the deck?

Card Q&A.a: Yes, you can. If an effect activates, it is to be fully resolved even if the card that activated the effect is removed from that area during the processing.
